people.name: Sarah
people.line: Wife of Abraham; mother of Isaac

translations.web: Yahweh visited Sarah as he had said, and Yahweh did to Sarah as he had spoken.
translations.bsb: Now the LORD attended to Sarah as He had said, and the LORD did for Sarah what He had promised.
translations.kjv: And the LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did unto Sarah as he had spoken.
translations.asv: And Jehovah visited Sarah as he had said, and Jehovah did unto Sarah as he had spoken.
